edits.headline: Four soldiers killed in fire at Canadian base in Alberta
edits.subheadline: Prime Minister Mark Carney said four people died and dozens were injured in the fire at CFB Wainwright, CTV News reported.
editorialBody: Four people were killed and dozens injured in a fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta, Prime Minister Mark Carney said, CTV News reported. The names of the four soldiers have been released and the cause of the fire is under investigation, Castanet reported.
In France, police said a record 855 people were arrested over protest violence in Paris, AFP reported.
In India, Punjab BJP chief Kewal Singh Dhillon wore a black turban in protest against the AAP state government, the Hans India reported.
Pakistan's army said it responded to firing by Afghan Taliban forces in Upper Kurram, Radio Pakistan reported on 17 October.
